lines.py: zhǔ guǎn zài chē jiān kāi huì de shí hou, zhǐ shuō le yí jù: “yǐ qián wǒ zhǐ huì kàn shéi kuài. xiàn zài wǒ zhī dào le, yǒu de rén màn, shì zài tì dà jiā bǎ guān.”
lines.en: At a workshop meeting, the supervisor says just one thing: "I used to look only at who was fast. Now I know some people are slow because they're checking for the rest of us."
